literal_meaning: টানা (continuous pulling) এবং কাড়া (snatching or grabbing)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাজারে টানাকাড়া না করে এক জায়গায় থাকো।
example_sentences_in_english: He keeps coming and going all day long.
Stop running back and forth in the market and stay in one place.
note: The idiom evokes the image of incessant tugging or movement, common in rural or everyday Bengali expressions.
